summary: Ares Strategic Income Fund filed an 8-K reporting that its reconvened 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders was adjourned due to lack of quorum (50% of outstanding shares required). No votes were held on trustee elections or ratification of KPMG LLP as auditor. The fund will not reconvene and will hold its next meeting in 2027; the current board continues serving. The auditor appointment is not contingent on shareholder ratification. This is a routine procedural update with no special-situations event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic review.
